headline: Google's AI-equipped satellite transmitted its first response from orbit, as Wired reported new AI-powered infostealer malware and an AI agent that autonomously injected a gene therapy into a live mouse's brain.

points.text: Google said its AI chip-equipped satellite successfully booted up its onboard Tensor Processing Units and generated its first response transmitted from orbit.
Wired reported on 'Volta-Autodoxer,' newly uncovered malware that uses AI tools to compile detailed dossiers on victims, including login credentials and financial data.
A biotech startup let an AI agent autonomously choose and administer a gene therapy injection into a live mouse's brain, illustrating the growing autonomy of lab research agents.
